convention: One conceptual unit of infrastructure: how the cockpit is packaged and released. Every CA on this unit is read from here; the global manifest at ../MANIFEST-advice.json reads this file. CA-046 comes from cockpit.constitution line 147 under CO-087.

units.summary: The cockpit will be released as an optional plugin under the parent flightcrew plugin. It will fit in seamlessly, and using it will not be required.
